name: synthesis-duplicate-across-groups
description: Two groups flagged the same truncated-write risk in save, one in detail and one tersely; the other two findings are distinct

findings.body: `save` opens the destination for writing and dumps into it in place, so a crash mid-write leaves a truncated file the next `load` cannot parse. Write to a temporary file in the same directory and rename it over the target.
`save` can corrupt the file if the process dies while writing.
`get` loads a caller-supplied path with no check, so a request can read any file the process can open.
`load` raises a raw FileNotFoundError for an unknown path, which `get` passes straight to the HTTP layer instead of a 404.
